description.value:
Your eyes turn to hollow pits of dread power for the duration. Choose a creature you can see within 60 feet; it must succeed on a Constitution save or fall under one of the following effects of your choosing for the duration. On each later turn, you may use your action to instead target a different creature, though a creature that has already saved successfully against this casting cannot be targeted again.

Asleep. The target falls unconscious, waking if it takes damage or another creature spends its action to rouse it.

Panicked. The target becomes frightened of you, forced to Dash away from you by the safest route available on each of its turns; the effect ends once it is at least 60 feet away and can no longer see you.

Sickened. The target suffers disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks, and may attempt a new Constitution save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 6
